pair_law.source: params_default.json with kappa = 0.41721 and A = sqrt(21136.56/(2 pi)) from the WP-C pair batch (outputs/session2/wpC/analysis/criteria.json row C3, kappa_measure_i: kappa 0.41721, C 21136.56). E, N, hw, omega, domega_dN unchanged from the default: the batch fits only the pair-law shape (kappa, C), and does not measure these better than the single-lump family does.

params.model_B_note: Model B = Model A(params) + (F_sup - F_asym) of the profile in fsup_table; incomplete below about d = 12 (core polarization missing), undefined below d = 3

outcome_definitions.merger: some pair below 2 hw (start above 2 hw)
outcome_definitions.collapse: start already at or below 2 hw: some pair below half the starting spacing (model B: or below d = 3, where its table ends)
outcome_definitions.flies apart: every lump's nearest-neighbour distance above 1.5 times its start value at T = 1000; time is when the last lump crossed 1.5
outcome_definitions.partly dispersed: some but not all lumps above 1.5 at T = 1000; time is the first crossing
outcome_definitions.bounded: none of the above by T = 1000 (mean_pair_distance_change_rel gives the drift; at spacing 30 the forces are too weak for anything to resolve in T = 1000)
outcome_definitions.N_model_invalid_from_t: first time some |N_i - N0| > 0.1 N0, beyond which the linear omega(N) is not valid
